source: Independent Astra static review followed by parent62-test qualification with patched authority retry case.
finding: Exact duplicate issuance using the original deadline failed after expiry before retained-ID lookup.
resolution: Future-deadline validation now applies only to new issuance. Exact expired retry returns retained permit and unchanged deadline; changed binding and reclaimed ID reject.
integration_requirements: Actual control-FD exclusivity and authenticated agent role must be runtime-tested.
Cache namespace must bind opaque task lifetime plus resource/implementation generations so late old producers cannot repopulate a new scope.
Prepared borrowed bindings must be copied before asynchronous execution.
Transport delivery and client acknowledgment are different facts; reconnect may replay output without repeating the backing effect.
